import pandas as pd

def main():
    # Source file paths
    source_files = [
        "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_48/test_0.csv"
        # If there were more sources, list them here
    ]

    # List to hold transformed DataFrames from each source
    transformed_dfs = []

    for file_path in source_files:
        # Load source data
        df = pd.read_csv(file_path)

        # Inspect columns:
        # ['Text Date', 'Value Date', 'Zip Code', 'Water Use', 'Power Use']

        # Transformation plan:
        # - Target schema: ['Date': string, 'Water Use': float, 'Power Use': integer]
        # - Use 'Text Date' as 'Date' (string)
        # - Aggregate by 'Text Date' (group by)
        # - Aggregate Water Use by sum (float)
        # - Aggregate Power Use by sum (integer)
        # - Convert Power Use to integer after aggregation

        # Group by 'Text Date' and aggregate
        grouped = df.groupby('Text Date', dropna=False).agg({
            'Water Use': 'sum',
            'Power Use': 'sum'
        }).reset_index()

        # Rename 'Text Date' to 'Date'
        grouped = grouped.rename(columns={'Text Date': 'Date'})

        # Ensure data types
        grouped['Water Use'] = grouped['Water Use'].astype(float)
        grouped['Power Use'] = grouped['Power Use'].round().astype(int)

        transformed_dfs.append(grouped)

    # Concatenate all transformed dataframes (if multiple sources)
    if len(transformed_dfs) > 1:
        final_df = pd.concat(transformed_dfs, ignore_index=True)
        # Since multiple sources might have overlapping dates, aggregate again
        final_df = final_df.groupby('Date', dropna=False).agg({
            'Water Use': 'sum',
            'Power Use': 'sum'
        }).reset_index()
        final_df['Water Use'] = final_df['Water Use'].astype(float)
        final_df['Power Use'] = final_df['Power Use'].round().astype(int)
    else:
        final_df = transformed_dfs[0]

    # Save to target path
    target_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_48/target_multisource_cot.csv"
    final_df.to_csv(target_path, index=False)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
